package.name: ShapeBert
package.description: Bridge that lets AI assistants (Claude Code and other MCP clients) build and check parametric FreeCAD parts, with an engineering knowledge base, exact calculators and CalculiX FEA checks. Local only, every request signed, and AI-written code needs your OK in a dialog.

other.name: ShapeBert bridge
other.description: Starts the local bridge in FreeCAD's GUI after you agree to it (freecad/shapebert/init_gui.py).
